scientific_integrity: An all-order analytic Cauchy--Schwarz lower bound and an involutory-permutation exact optimizer; standalone exact-rational finite tests are corroborating only. No external validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected simple noncomplete undirected graphs of N>=3; symmetric entrywise-nonnegative stochastic kernels with holding allowed and uniform stationary distribution. The degree-based obstruction is not claimed sharp for all larger complement degrees. Publication priority not independently established.
title: Missing-edge rigidity for the fastest symmetric Markov chain on noncomplete graphs
